segments.title: 第47章 放學等我
segments.content:
After dinner was evening self-study.

Kong Junxiang came to the classroom, turned on the projector on the teacher's podium, and said with a smile, "School has just started, and the textbooks haven't been handed out yet. I was afraid you'd be bored during self-study, so let's watch a movie."

As he spoke, Kong Junxiang operated the projector while looking toward the window by the corridor.

Just as he was about to say something, Li Luo, sitting in the back row, spoke first, "Ren Zheng, Fang Chen, please draw the curtains. Zhang Guohuang, close the back door."

Suddenly hearing Li Luo call their names, the two students by the window were a bit stunned.

Zhang Guohuang, however, was the first to react. He shot up, ran to the back, and closed the door.

By this time, the other two students had also come to their senses and quickly drew the curtains.

Kong Junxiang glanced at Li Luo, then at Ren Zheng and Fang Chen by the window, silently matching their names to their faces in his mind.

Generally speaking, it was a rather slow process for a teacher to remember the names of all the students in a class.

Especially a teacher of a specific subject, who often taught two classes.

For minor subjects, it could be even more.

No teacher could match all the students' names with their faces on the first day of school.

But this class president of his seemed to have actually managed it.

He had originally thought it was some kind of speed-memorization technique, the kind one would forget after a while.

Now it seemed that wasn't the case.

As he was thinking, Kong Junxiang opened a downloaded movie. As the opening scene of *Snowpiercer* came into view, he walked to the door, turned off the classroom lights, and then called the four class committee members, including Li Luo, out.

"The evening meeting is in a classroom on the sixth floor. You can go up now," Kong Junxiang said to Li Luo.

"This is really cruel," Li Luo sighed. "I'd actually rather watch the movie."

"Then why don't you give the class president position to me?" Hua Xiuxiu chimed in unexpectedly.

"Why are you always plotting to usurp my position?"

"Heh." Hearing their exchange, Kong Junxiang chuckled, then reminded them, "The class committee will be re-elected after the military training. Li Luo, you'd better perform well, or you might really be usurped."

Li Luo raised an eyebrow, thinking to himself, *There's something that good?*

"Alright, Teacher Kong, we'll head up then."

Li Luo led the way upstairs, with Hua Xiuxiu, Yan Zhusheng, and Zhu Yufei following behind, all heading to classroom 601.

The classrooms on the sixth floor had no permanent classes and were usually empty.

They were used for things like student meetings, club activities, or some open classes.

When Li Luo and the others arrived at the door of classroom 601, more than half of the classes had already arrived.

Li Luo walked into the classroom and immediately saw Ying Chanxi sitting in the front row.

Ying Chanxi was sitting in a middle seat, with a rather handsome boy to her right.

Seeing Li Luo enter, Ying Chanxi raised her hand and made a gesture at her chest, pointing to the empty seat to her left.

Li Luo understood immediately and walked straight over, unceremoniously sitting down to Ying Chanxi's left under the watchful eyes of everyone.

At the same time, however, Yan Zhusheng captured the entire classroom's attention.

Without a school uniform, Yan Zhusheng was still in her casual clothes. Her tight jeans perfectly accentuated her long, slender legs, and coupled with her cool and calm face, she instantly grabbed everyone's line of sight.

Even the boy sitting next to Ying Chanxi couldn't help but look up for a few more glances.

But under these circumstances, Yan Zhusheng followed behind Li Luo and habitually sat in the empty seat next to him.

And just like that, with Ying Chanxi to his right and Yan Zhusheng to his left, Li Luo instantly became the focal point of the classroom.

The moment Yan Zhusheng entered, Ying Chanxi's gaze had already shifted to her. It was only after Yan Zhusheng sat down that Ying Chanxi looked away.

Perhaps because there were many people around, Ying Chanxi didn't strike up a conversation with Li Luo, just sitting there quietly, appearing serene and tranquil.

Even the vice class president from Class 1 next to her didn't quite dare to initiate a conversation with her.

"Just now, Teacher Kong said the class committee will be re-elected after military training." At this moment, Yan Zhusheng suddenly said to Li Luo, "If I withdraw from the election then, does that mean I won't have to be the sports committee member anymore?"

"I think you're overthinking it," Li Luo glanced at Yan Zhusheng, who was always looking for a chance to slack off. "What if no one runs for the female sports committee member position at all?"

"Hmm..." Yan Zhusheng fell into deep thought, realizing that seemed to make sense, and became a little troubled.

Beside them, Ying Chanxi, hearing their conversation, secretly perked up her ears. She clutched her pen tightly, repeatedly uncapping and capping it, looking a bit agitated.

The vice class president, Jian Zhenyuan, noticed Ying Chanxi's small movements and thought to himself, *Is it because the teacher is late, delaying our dear class president's study time?*

"The teacher's here," Ying Chanxi suddenly said toward Li Luo. "Be quiet."

The Dean of Students walked in from the classroom entrance and made his way to the podium.

Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng stopped talking, and the entire classroom fell silent.

"My surname is Liu. You can call me Teacher Liu." The Dean of Students looked at the students with a smile and introduced himself, "Those of you from Classes 1 to 4, we've met before. For students from other classes, this should be our first time meeting."

"The main purpose of this meeting, on the surface, is to go over the important points for the military training."

"Additionally, it's a chance to meet you all and get familiar. Today's meeting is pretty casual, so don't be nervous."

As the Dean of Students, Teacher Liu was not a rigid teacher. While explaining the various notices about military training, he would call on a student from time to time.

He would ask for their name and class, and chat a bit about some little gossip regarding their class teacher. Bursts of laughter would ring out in the classroom from time to time, and the time passed quickly.

After more than half an hour, Teacher Liu announced the end of the meeting, and the students all stood up to leave the classroom.

As she was leaving, Ying Chanxi looked at Li Luo and said in a low voice, "Wait for me in the classroom after school lets out. We'll go back together."

"Sure," Li Luo nodded.

Ying Chanxi's voice wasn't loud, but several students from Class 1 and Class 8 heard her clearly.

Jian Zhenyuan, the vice class president of Class 1, shuddered, looking at Li Luo in disbelief as if he had misheard.

On the other side from Class 8, Yan Zhusheng didn't pay much mind, and Zhu Yufei didn't have much of a reaction either, since he knew Li Luo was Ying Chanxi's cousin.

In Hua Xiuxiu's memory, Ying Chanxi and Li Luo seemed to have been quite close back in middle school, so his reaction wasn't as dramatic as those from Class 1.

However, on the way downstairs, Hua Xiuxiu still asked curiously, "You're not dating Ying Chanxi, are you?"

"What?" Before Li Luo could be surprised, Zhu Yufei had already cried out, "Aren't they brother and sister? Can they date?"

As soon as he said that, Yan Zhusheng immediately showed a curious expression and looked at Li Luo.

At this point, Li Luo's face was full of dark lines. He looked at Hua Xiuxiu, then at Zhu Yufei, "Who told you I'm Ying Chanxi's younger brother?"

"Liu Shaowen said so," Zhu Yufei said, scratching his head. "Isn't it true?"

Li Luo: "..."

*What a character... Ying Chanxi jokingly said I was her younger brother, and Liu Shaowen actually believed it?*

With that thought, Li Luo didn't bother explaining much. He just said righteously, "I'm her cousin. Don't get it wrong."
